data.content_ref: inline:The target's distinguishing-evidence criterion is demonstrably unreliable. It equates Poisson-distributed counts / exponential inter-arrival with 'truly independent' and heavy-tailed/clustering with 'hidden shared cause,' but independent renewal processes with non-exponential inter-arrival times produce clustered, overdispersed failure counts with no shared cause at all. Thus the proposed signature does not distinguish independence from correlation as the problem requires.
